Inside the simulator

The underdog (red) attacks right; the stronger team (blue) attacks left. Each dot is a player, and each run shows the first 6 minutes of a simulated match.

underdogstrong teamball
This is a research simulator, not a game engine. Keepers are implicit, and players move toward target spots chosen by each team's tactic. Results from it count only if they survive a realism check against real match data.
